case.amplicon_range_bp: 303 bp exactly; verified span CM000681.2:21,658,631-21,658,933 (GRCh38 chr19)
case.caveats: 303 bp is the NULL (unoccupied) allele, not a provirus amplicon - the paper is explicit that homozygous-insertion individuals give no band, because the occupied allele adds ~9.5 kb. GRCh38 lacks K113, so the reference chromosome carries the empty site and the assay is contained. On the plus strand of CM000681.2 the primer listed as 'reverse' (K113-r) reads forward; orientation must be handled. Both 20-mers are unique in the GRCh38 primary assembly (BLAT: one primary hit each, plus one alt contig chr19_GL383575v2_alt). Template is a whole chromosome (58.6 Mb).
case.citation: Jha AR, Pillai SK, York VA, Sharp ER, Storm EC, Wachter DJ, Martin JN, Deeks SG, Rosenberg MG, Nixon DF, Garrison KE. Cross-sectional dating of novel haplotypes of HERV-K 113 and HERV-K 115 indicate these proviruses originated in Africa before Homo sapiens. Mol Biol Evol. 2009;26(11):2617-2626. doi:10.1093/molbev/msp180. PMID 19666991; PMCID PMC2760466.
case.element: HERV-K(HML-2) provirus K113 - LTR retroelement (betaretrovirus-like ERV); insertion-site / empty-allele PCR at 19p13.11
case.loci_justification: The pair flanks one locus on the cited template: a single insertion site, a single excision site, or a single transcript. A second product on this template would be an off-target prediction.
case.name: HERV-K113 pre-integration (empty) site PCR
case.where_in_paper: Primer sequences: Supplementary table 2 ('PCR primers and annealing temperatures'), row 'K113 insertion site', primers K113-f / K113-r (attributed there to Turner et al. 2001 and Burmeister et al. 2004). Amplicon size: Materials and Methods, PCR paragraph - 'The K113 integration site was detected by primer pairs K113-f/K113-r, which amplified a band of 303 bp in K113 null and heterozygous individuals'. Gel-derived on 1-2% agarose against a 100-bp ladder.
case.worked_prediction_note: The entry records a worked prediction — a coordinate range, an in-silico check, or a sequence-derived length — so the expected answer was written down before the engine ran. The published size remains external, but this case was not scored blind.
